newsitem.title: USA: Virogroup says CFO Larry Ackerly resigns.
newsitem.headline: Virogroup says CFO Larry Ackerly resigns.

text.p: ViroGroup Inc Tuesday said Chief Financial Officer Larry Ackerly has resigned, effective February 28.

A Nashville-based chief financial officer will be named soon, the company said. The firm plans to move its corporate offices to Nashville by the end of the current fiscal year, and said that Ackerly decided to stay in Florida.
ViroGroup provides a full range of environmental, hydrogeological, hazardous waste and solid waste management services to correct and improve air, water and soil quality.
